_comment: Which official conformance scenarios this stdio server must pass (task.testing.022).
required: every check SUCCESS or INFO. required_checks: these checks SUCCESS or INFO.
not_applicable: the category and reason; the observed result is still recorded and compared.
Every scenario upstream reports must be listed here, and no scenario may report a wire error.

caching.reason: Only the tools checks apply; prompts and resources are not offered.
